children: Japanese stocks are higher in early trade on continued hopes that artificial intelligence-related demand will support domestic earnings. Chip stocks are leading the gains. Kioxia Holdings is up 4.2% and Advantest is 2.4% higher. The dollar is at 157.87 yen, compared with Y157.82 as of Tuesday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are closely watching domestic earnings as well as the Fed's rate decision later Wednesday. Advantest is set to release its results later Wednesday. The Nikkei Stock Average is up 1.3% at 64087.11. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
